feature_title: Workflows Canvas Branch Connectors & Control Polish

rationale.edition: Checked the complete changed-files list (21 files). Every path lives under web/src/** (plugins/workflows, components/workflows, components/flow, locales/languages) or scripts/** — none are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/. No enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the paths or changed symbols, so this is classified as an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no explicit opt-out (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty, and no tests-added label was passed). The diff is not docs/CI-only: it modifies three user-facing Vue components (WorkflowCanvas, WorkflowNode, WorkflowsList) plus locale strings, so it is a user-facing change rather than a no-op.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. WorkflowCanvas.vue changes how branch-node arm connectors are positioned (each arm now originates from its own handle offset instead of every arm converging on one point), WorkflowNode.vue changes the disabled/mute/comment badge layout (flex-wrap + max-width), and WorkflowsList.vue changes the resume action variant from ghost to ghost-success. These alter user-visible rendering and control appearance in the Workflows UI, which existing Workflows specs already cover.
rationale.area: Area is Workflows. The three substantive code changes all live in workflows UI files (web/src/plugins/workflows/*, web/src/components/workflows/*), and the locale changes are almost entirely within the workflow.* translation namespace. There is an existing Workflows test folder (workflows-crud.spec.js, workflows-negative.spec.js) to house the sibling spec.
rationale.group: playwright_group is Workflows. The ci-matrix has a Workflows shard (testfolder 'Workflows', actual_folder 'Workflows') whose run_files contain the existing workflows-crud.spec.js and workflows-negative.spec.js; the new spec belongs alongside those.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/components/flow/forms/DestinationPicker.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test, not a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so it does not count as existing E2E coverage and existing_tests_in_diff is false.
